It sorts the files right in the Downloads folder into a folder for each kind of file, such as images, documents and archives.
It only moves files: it never deletes, renames or overwrites one.
Run plainly, it shows what it would move and moves nothing; it moves only when told to.
It runs on macOS and Linux.
A README says how to install and use it, and tests check that it does the above.
A file whose name is already taken in its kind's folder is left where it is and reported.
It can undo its last run, moving each file it moved back where it was. (on reading the plan)
